scope.reason: Cross-cuts parser, authorization, chat handler, persistence, protected API, cached health sharing, navigation, frontend, tests, and bilingual docs.

integration.reason: Uses existing internal API, PostgreSQL, and Twitch EventSub data; no new external integration.

infrastructure.reason: Requires persistent policy storage and real PostgreSQL migration-backed contract tests; likely additive migration or existing JSON setting contract.

knowledge.reason: Existing patterns cover these technologies, but command catalog-to-runtime parity and per-command authorization require careful domain design.

risk.reason: A permission regression may expose queue mutations or change access during a live stream.

flags: Preserve current policy as migration/default behavior
Do not start FND-7 planning before this implementation is complete
